verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs confirm the core capability: an Issues page for debugging errors with stack traces and suspect commits/PR comments, release and source map management via the CLI, and alerting on new issue creation which implies issue grouping/regression logic. Community comments corroborate deep, reliable use of Sentry for error monitoring in production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of regression detection (e.g., resolved-then-reoccurred issue flagging) and independent hands-on verification of grouping accuracy.
